full_prompt_en: A square, stylized portrait illustration places a woman's pale face in close left-facing profile among dark blue-gray leaves and rust-red blossoms. The background is tightly filled rather than open: curling floral shapes, pale cream fragments, and deep shadowed spaces appear at the outer edges. Her head occupies most of the central area, with the forehead rising beyond the top of the selected image and the chin tapering toward the lower center. A single hazel-brown eye looks toward the left edge, its carefully drawn lids and brow set into smooth, softly graduated skin tones. The nose projects toward the left, and the small mouth carries glossy crimson lipstick. At the right side of her face, a large slate-blue leaf curves around the temple, its fine parallel veins following the contour. A pale folded petal and smaller dark curls overlap near the ear, while warm orange berry-like accents punctuate the surrounding blue-gray forms. At the upper right, rounded red-orange flower heads sit against a dark recess. Another broad red blossom rises from the lower right corner, its petal folds described with fine directional lines and deeper maroon shadows. Near the left edge, scrolling brown and gray ornamental foliage provides an intricate counterpart to the broad smooth cheek. A dark garment or shadow under the jaw merges with the dense lower background, so the face remains the principal light shape. The drawing combines crisp, decorative contours with smooth modeling inside the skin and petals. Deep blue-gray, rusty orange, cream, and scarlet remain distinct but are tied together by subdued brown shadows. The light falls gently across the forehead, nose, and cheek from the upper left, leaving the far side warmer and darker without hard cast shadows. Fine surface striations give the leaves and flowers a carved, carefully ordered quality, while the face appears polished and nearly porcelain-smooth. There is no readable lettering. The overall composition is intimate and densely framed, using curved ornamental forms to set off a quiet profile and its small vivid red accents.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形的风格化肖像插画：女子浅色面容以朝左的近距离侧脸呈现，周围环绕深蓝灰叶片和锈红花朵。背景被形体紧密填满，而非留出空白；卷曲的花叶、浅奶油色碎片和深暗间隙分布在画面外缘。她的头部占据中央大部分区域，额头向上超出所选画面，尖细的下巴伸向下方中央。一只榛褐色眼睛望向左边，精心描绘的眼睑与眉毛嵌在柔和平滑渐变的肤色中。鼻梁伸向左侧，小巧嘴唇涂着有光泽的深红色。脸的右侧，一片大的石板蓝叶子沿太阳穴弯曲，细密平行的叶脉顺着轮廓伸展。浅色折叠花瓣与较小的深色卷叶在耳边交叠，暖橙色的浆果状小点穿插在周围蓝灰形体间。右上角，圆润的红橙色花朵贴着深色空隙。另一朵宽大的红花从右下角升起，花瓣褶皱以细密定向线条和更深的栗红阴影描绘。左边缘，褐色与灰色的卷曲装饰叶形，与宽阔平滑的面颊形成繁密对照。下颌之下的深色衣物或暗部并入密集的下方背景，使面容成为主要的明亮形块。画法把清楚的装饰性轮廓与皮肤、花瓣内部的平滑塑形结合。深蓝灰、锈橙、奶油色和猩红各自分明，又由低调的褐色阴影联结。柔光从左上落在额头、鼻梁与脸颊上，使背光一侧更暖、更暗，没有强烈投影。细密表面线纹赋予叶片和花朵雕刻般精心排列的质感，脸部则光洁得近似瓷面。画中没有可读文字。整体构图亲密而密集，以弯曲的装饰形体衬托安静侧脸和少量鲜艳红色重点。
style_prompt_en: Polished illustrative painting joins smooth tonal modeling to sharply organized decorative contours. Broad pale areas serve as the main visual rest, while overlapping dark blue-gray shapes and rusty warm accents crowd the margins with curved, interlocking rhythms. Some surfaces remain almost porcelain-smooth; others carry fine parallel striations that follow each bend and give the forms a carved quality. Cream highlights and small scarlet or orange accents punctuate the cool, shadowed mass without breaking its unity. Edges alternate between crisp ornamental boundaries and gentle transitions of value inside the larger forms. Soft light enters from one side, bringing pale areas forward while the darker recesses hold the surrounding pattern together. The overall effect is elegant, intimate, and densely composed, with restrained depth beneath an elaborate surface design.
style_prompt_zh: 精致的绘画式插画将平滑明暗塑形与组织严谨的装饰轮廓结合。宽阔的浅色区域成为主要视觉停歇处，重叠的深蓝灰形块和锈暖色强调在边缘形成弯曲、互锁的密集节奏。一些表面几乎像瓷面一样光滑，另一些则带有顺着弯折方向排列的细密平行线纹，赋予形体雕刻感。奶油色亮部与少量猩红或橙色重点点缀冷暗的大块面，同时不破坏整体统一。边缘在清晰的装饰边界和大形体内部柔和的明度过渡之间交替。柔光从一侧进入，把浅色区域推向前方，较深的凹处则将周围纹样凝聚在一起。整体效果优雅、亲密且构图繁密，精巧表面设计之下保留克制的纵深。
theme_en: A woman's pale side profile framed by ornamental leaves and red flowers
theme_zh: 装饰性叶片和红花环绕下的女子浅色侧脸
name: Catherine Abel
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
